valid:
run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj u1, u2 : User |
    some disj a, n : Photo |
    some d : Day {
        User = u1 + u2
        Influencer = none
        Photo = a + n
        Ad = a
        Day = d
        User <: follows = u1->u2
        User <: sees = u1->a
        User <: posts = u1->a + u2->n
        User <: suggested = none->none
        Photo <: date = a->d + n->d
    }
} for exactly 2 User, exactly 2 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

valid:
run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj p1, p2 : Person |
    some disj c1, c2 : Course |
    some g : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = p2
        Course = c1 + c2
        Project = none
        Grade = g
        Person <: teaches = p1->c1 + p2->c2
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1
        Person <: projects = none->none
        Course <: projects = none->none
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 2 Person, exactly 2 Course, exactly 0 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

run NegativeScenario2 {
    some disj p1, p2, s1 : Person |
    some disj c1, c2 : Course |
    some x : Project |
    some g : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2 + s1
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = p2 + s1
        Course = c1 + c2
        Project = x
        Grade = g
        Person <: teaches = p1->c1 + p2->c2
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1 + s1->c1
        Person <: projects = s1->x
        Course <: projects = c1->x
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 3 Person, exactly 2 Course, exactly 1 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj p1, p2, p3, s1 : Person |
    some disj c1, c2, c3 : Course |
    some disj x1, x2 : Project |
    some disj g1, g2 : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2 + p3 + s1
        Professor = p1 + p2 + p3
        Student = p2 + s1
        Course = c1 + c2 + c3
        Project = x1 + x2
        Grade = g1 + g2
        Person <: teaches = p1->c1 + p2->c2 + p3->c3
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1 + s1->c1 + s1->c3
        Person <: projects = s1->x1 + s1->x2
        Course <: projects = c1->x1 + c3->x2
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = g1->g2
    }
} for exactly 4 Person, exactly 3 Course, exactly 2 Project, exactly 2 Grade expect 0
